changes_made.explanation: Minor normalization of model names. All extracted metadata was accurate and relevant for this paper which addresses Visual Question Answering - an NLG task requiring text generation.
Normalized to consistent capitalization. The paper explicitly uses VQA Accuracy as defined by the standard VQA metric formula provided in the text.
No LLMs are used as judges in this paper. The models mentioned (BLIP2, Flan-T5, etc.) are used for generation, not for evaluation.
The paper does not mention any human evaluation. All evaluation is conducted using automatic VQA Accuracy metric.

overall_notes: The original extraction was quite accurate. This paper proposes a framework for knowledge selection and question answering using visual-language models, evaluating on the OK-VQA dataset with standard VQA Accuracy metric. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods are used. The paper focuses on improving VQA performance through self-bootstrapping between selector and answerer modules.
